picks.title: Cascadeur Ships 2026.2 with Animation Layers and 3 New Languages
picks.excerpt: Nekki's physics- and AI-assisted character animation tool adds additive animation layers, easing controls, retrained inbetweening/motion-generation/retargeting networks, and a built-in MCP server that lets external AI agents drive the software. A concrete look at where neural assistance sits inside a working animation pipeline.
picks.rationale: Shipping tool release an animator can install tomorrow — animation layers plus an MCP server that opens the app to external AI agents is the most actionable item in the pool.

picks.title: After Chaos Of Cruise Vs Pitt AI Deepfakes, Seedance 2.5 Is Now Blocking Hollywood Rip-Offs
picks.excerpt: ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 is now refusing prompts that reproduce Hollywood IP and star likenesses, after Seedance 2.0 triggered an outrage cycle over Cruise-vs-Pitt deepfakes. A rare look at guardrails being retrofitted into a mainstream video model creators actually use.
picks.rationale: Changes what prompts actually run for anyone using Seedance in production — retrofitted IP and likeness guardrails in the model creators lean on most.

picks.title: A Filmmaker Secured a Lost Billy Joel Radio Interview. Then He Re-Created the Singer in AI
picks.excerpt: A documentary filmmaker found a lost Billy Joel radio interview and used AI to reconstruct a young Billy Joel on screen — without the artist's involvement. A sharp case study in the consent gap opening up around AI-assisted documentary reenactment.
picks.rationale: A concrete, reproducible documentary technique paired with the consent question it forces — the clearest craft-ethics case study of the week.

picks.title: AI-Generated Turkish Series 'Castle Walls' Launches on Prime Video in What Is Being Touted as a First
picks.excerpt: AI-generated historical drama 'Castle Walls,' produced by Turkish TV powerhouse Ay Yapim, launches on Prime Video as what is billed as the first series made end-to-end with generative AI for a major streamer. It is a concrete test of whether a fully synthetic production pipeline can carry a scripted series.
picks.rationale: First end-to-end generative-AI scripted series to land on a major streamer — the benchmark everyone building a synthetic pipeline will now be measured against.

picks.title: RocXZoom Heading to Kickstarter – Robotic 50x Zoom Camera With AI Subject Tracking From Ex-DJI Engineers
picks.excerpt: Ex-DJI engineers are crowdfunding RocXZoom, a robotic 50x zoom camera whose AI subject tracking handles framing and follow automatically. On-set machine vision is moving from post into the camera body itself.
picks.rationale: Moves AI from post into the camera body — automatic framing and follow is an on-set production change, and the only hardware angle in the pool.
